svg.title: DBTL directed-evolution workflow with agents at the interfaces
svg.desc: Four DBTL stages each show techniques, equipment and software from Zhang et al., Nature Communications 2025. Four proposed interface agents manage the handoffs between Design, Build, Test, Learn, and the next Design round. A coordinator ensures oversight and integrity.
svg.text: Interface agents for a DBTL directed-evolution workflow
Case study: pCNF-RS evolution · Zhang et al., Nature Communications (2025)
Solid arrows: DBTL flow through interface agents · Dashed lines: coordination and oversight
Proposed architecture · not implemented in the original study
